Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the West Indies' first innings. The Sri Lankan players after getting into huddle spread out on the field. They are followed by the two West Indies openers, Kraigg Brathwaite and John Campbell. Suranga Lakmal to start with the ball for Sri Lanka. Here we go...

With around 18 overs remaining in the day, West Indies would look to end the day unscathed and also look to wipe off the deficit to some extent. Can they do it with ease or will the Sri Lankan bowlers cause problems for them? Join us for West Indies' batting in their first essay in a short while.

The bowling from West Indies was spot on as Roach, Holder, Cornwall and Joseph all bowled superbly. Gabriel though was off-colour today as he struggled to maintain a tight line and length on a consistent basis. Overall it was a good disciplined effort from the Men in Maroon which saw them skittle the Lankan Lions for a meagre score. The star for them was none other than, Jason Holder who took wickets for fun today to bring up his milestone of 200 first-class wickets as well as bagged his 8th Test fifer. Roach had 3 to his name too as Cornwall had a wicket too to show in front of his name. To add to the efforts of the bowlers their fielders too fielded exceptionally well.

Sri Lanka after being put in to bat by West Indies started on a watchful note but that over defensiveness from them caused them to surrender meekly. Lahiru Thirimanne managed to show some fight as he scored 70-odd runs. Apart from him on Niroshan Dickwella got the start but he threw it away by playing an irresponsible shot. In the end, Sri Lanka folded in their first essay with the bat.

Another poor batting display from Sri Lanka see them tottering with a first Innings score of 169. Brilliant bowling from West Indies especially, Jason Holder who troubled the Lankan batsmen with the bounce and accuracy.

OUT! LBW! Umpire's call on hitting the wickets and Holder has 5. Excellent performance from him and West Indies. He beats the batsman with pace and swing once again. This one is fullish and outside off. Lands and comes back in sharply. Embuldeniya plays all around it and fails to put any bat on ball and gets struck on the pad. Big appeal from Holder and the others. The umpire thinks and then raises his finger. Embuldeniya reviews again. This time the DRS won't be saving him as Ultra Edge shows no bat and Ball Tracker shows umpire's call on hitting the wickets. Holder and West Indies celebrate. Sri Lanka have been bowled out for 169.

Embuldeniya has been given out again. LBW once again but he has asked for the review again. Is there any bat? Ultra Edge shows nothing. Here comes's the Ball Tracker. Umpire's call on hitting the wickets.
Back of a length and just outside off, poked towars point for nothing.
Beaten again! Just outside off on a good length. This one shapes back in. Lasith looks to defend but misses to put bat on ball.
Play and a miss! Shortish in length and outside off, Embuldeniya pokes at it to get beaten.
Beaten! Another excellent over from Roach. Fuller and just around off, Fernando pokes at it to get beaten.
Full and around off, blocked.

Edged but doesn't carry. Roach corrects his line and bowls this one just outside off on a fullish length. Vishwa looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge but falls short of the slip fielder.
Down the leg side. Left alone. Roach has overstepped.
Quick single. Good length delivery just outside off, Lasith punches it towards the cover region and takes one.
Good length and around middle, poked towards mid on for a single.
Around off on a good length, kept out.
This one is slipped down the leg side. Embuldeniya looks to flick but misses.
Good length ball around off, this time Lasith defends it nicely.

NOT OUT! Missing the leg pole. That was a lovely ball from Holder. He angled in to the left-hander from outside off. Embuldeniya looks to defend but he misses to get hit on the pad. A loud, loud appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Embuldeniya calls for the DRS and manages to reverse the on field call as Ball Tracker shows it to be going over the stumps. So, the Lankan innings will carry on. Excellent use of the DRS.
Review time! Embuldeniya has been given out LBW but he reviews it. Looks to be a goner. Well, well. Going over the stumps.
Good length and around off, kept out.

Back of a length ball outside off, shapes back in. Embuldeniya looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes uppishly towards Blackwood at short leg. Blackwood gets hands to it but fails to snaffle it. Two taken.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone.
Full and wide outsde off, moves further away. Vishwa lets it go to the keeper.
Sharp bouncer this time. Fernando sways away.
Around off on a good length, kept out.
Full and on middle, Vishwa looks to work it on the leg side but the ball takes the outer half and goes towards the cover region.
Another ripper! This is full and just outside off, Fernando looks to defend but misses.
Vishwa Fernando is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! The off pole has gone for the toss. Ripping delivery from Roach. Roach has been superb in this spell. He runs in and bowls a full ball just around off, Chameera is late in bringing his bat down. The ball sneaks below his willow and the off pole goes flying. Absolute peach from Kemar.
Appeal for LBW but not out says the umpire.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Shortish and around off, blocked.
Good length ball outside off, this one comes back on. Embuldeniya looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pad.
Fuller ball on the pads, Chameera looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball goes to fine leg for a leg bye.
Lasith Embuldeniya is in now. He will face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Holder has his 4th. Sri Lanka 8 down now. A good length ball around off and middle, Lakmal looks to flick but ends up getting a leading edge. The ball goes high in the air towards the backward point region. Brathwaite there runs behind and settles under it and takes the catch easily. Holder will be on a hat-trick now.
Outside off, left alone.
That is a ripper from Roach. How did that miss the stumps? Full and just outside off, Chameera looks to defend but the ball sneaks past the bat and goes past the stumps.
Chameera is up and running! A fuller ball on middle, he flicks it through mid-wicket and scampers back for two.
Length ball around off, kept out.
Banged short and on middle, Chameera sits under it.
Good length ball around off, pushed towards the cover region for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera is in now.

OUT! TIMBER! Holder strikes and removes dangerous Thirimanne. He is pumped as the set batsman heads to the pavilion. Another length ball outside off, it is angled in again. Thirimanne looks to reach at it and drive. He ends up dragging the ball onto the stumps. Big, big wicket. A valiant knock from Thirimanne because scoring has been tough but he would be disappointed as he walks off.
FOUR! Nicely done this time and Thirimanne moves into the 70s now. A length ball, angled in from outside off, Thirimanne does well to tuck it down to the fine leg fence.
EDGY! A fuller ball outside off, Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball takes the thick outside edge. It goes past the second slip fielder and down to third man. Two taken.
Around off on a length, kept out.
Lovely bowling. Good length and outside off, Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge.
WIDE! A bit too wide outside off, left alone. Wided by the umpire. Late movement there.
Full and around off, played back to the bowler.
Fullish and around off, Lakmal looks to defend but this one comes back in to him. The ball takeks the inner half and goes to mid-wicket.
Beaten! Good length and just outside off, a touch of movement away. Lakmal is beaten again, for the outside edge. Lucky not to nick it behind again.
Good length and on middle, it is tucked to the right side of the man at mid-wicket who keeps it down to a dot.
Lakmal is off the mark with a brace. A length ball on middle, Lakmal clips it behind square on the leg side and scampers back for two.
Good length and just outside off, this one goes away after pitching. Left alone this time by Suranga.
Lakmal gets beaten again. Probing line and length on the first ball of the new spell from Roach. It is just outside off on a good length. Lakmal pokes at it but gets beaten.
Kemar Roach is back again. 12-1-39-2 from him so far.
Full and around middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Another one angled across from the left-hander. Left alone again.
Gets a closer to the off pole but not enough to make the batsman play.
Good length and around middle, it is worked towards the leg side.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Good length and around off, pushed towards the off side.
Beaten again! Just outside off on a length, a bit of movement away from the batter. Lakmal looks to defend but is beaten.
Very full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and wide outside off, Lakam goes for the drive away from his body to get beaten. Loose from Lakmal.
Good length and around off, pushed towards point.

Nicely bowled. A yorker around off, Lakmal pushes it back to the bowler. Mayerks quickly picks it up in his followthrough and threatens to throw it to the batsman and forces him to get back in his crease.
Good length ball around middle, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Holder strikes and Rahkeem Cornwall does the rest. Nicely set up wicket this. Holder keeps on bowling the wide deliveries the previous over and continues to do the same in this over too. Finally, Dickwella runs out of patience as he tries to smash one down the ground. He though is nowhere in a position to play the stroke as he could manage just a thick outside edge which is gobbled up but Rahkeem Cornwall at first slip. Holder is successful in breaking the 58-run association
Holder lands one on a length and around middle,Dickwella blocks it off the back foot to mid on.
Full on off, stroked to covers.
Good length and around off, Niroshan punches it to point this time.
Pitched up on a fuller length and outside off, Dicwella shoulders bat to it.
Short of good length and around off, blocked off the back foot to mid off.
Full and outside off, Thirimanne drives it through covers and gets a brace. 150 comes up for Sri Lanka.
Outside off, left alone.
Short of a length and angled across the left-hander, Dickwella leaves it.

Full and outside off, Dickwella slashes at it and gets it uppishly over gully and towards third man. Joseph gives the chase and keeps the ball just inside the ropes. Three runs taken in the meantime. Good running this from the two batsmen.
Good length ball angling away from Niroshan, Dickwella leaves it comfortably.
Length and angled outside off, Dickwella makes a leave.
Kyle Mayers with the ball now.
Bumper on middle, Lahiru ducks under it.
Full and outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! Good length and going away from Thirimanne, Lahiru looks to poke at it but is beaten on the outside edge.
Full on middle, blocked out safely.
Stifled appeal but turned down! Length and on leg, Lahiru shuffles across his stumps before going for the flick. He though misses it as the ball goes off his pads to the leg side.
Full on leg, tucked in front of square for a single.
On middle, defended solidly.
Flighted on off, defended off the back foot.
Floated around middle, punched through cover-point for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Floated on off, solidly kept out.
Length and outside off, Thirimanne cuts it through point and gets three runs this time.
On leg, turned away to the leg side for a single.
Length and outside off, Thirimanne leaves it alone.
Length and outside off, Thirimanne looks to defend it but is beaten. The ball then swings late past the keeper and first slip. The ball goes to third man as the batsmen seek a couple of byes.
Outside off, left alone by Thirimanne.
Length and outside off, Thirimanne shoulders arms to it.
Full on middle, Dickwella tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
On off, Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Flatter and around middle, Niroshan turns it to mid-wicket for a single.
Darting on middle, defended right under the eyes by Dickwella.
Tossed up on leg, nudged to leg gully.
Floated around off, played to covers.
Slower and shorter outside off, Dickwella cuts it towards deep point for a brace.
Angled one on middle, Dickwella tucks it to the leg side.
Good length and outside off, Dickwella blocks it out to the off side.
Another length  ball and well outside off Niroshan has no interest to play at it.
Another length ball and outside off, Dickwella makes a leave.
Short of god length and outside off, Niroshan pushes it to point.
Outside off, Left alone by Dickwella.
WIDE! Sprayed one well outside off, Dickwella makes a leave. Wide called.
Jason Holder to bowl from the other end.
Fuller and outside off, Dickwella skips down the track and drives it through mid off for a single.
Flighted around off, Niroshan drives it to covers.
On middle, tucked to the leg side.
Tossed up around off, Dickwella blocks it off the front foot.
Floated and outside off, left alone.
Tossed up on middle, nudged to the leg side for a single.

We are back for the final session on Day 1. The West Indies players are out in the middle. They are followed by the two Sri Lankan batsmen, Niroshan Dickwella and Lahiru Thirimanne. Rahkeem Cornwall to start the final session of the day.
... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...
Another slow and sedate session is up on the cards as West Indies would look to wrap this Sri Lankan innings in the third session itself. Join us for the final session of Day 1 in about 15 minutes.

Bowling from the West Indies was superb. They kept bowling probing lines and kept frustrating the Sri Lankan batsmen. The end result was wickets which West Indies managed to get. Though a couple of wickets they took in this session but overall they would be happy to see half the Sri Lankan side back in the hut.

After the Lunch break, the Sri Lankan innings resumed sedately as runs were hard to come by as they took the defensive approach but that cost them the wicket of Dhananjaya de Silva and then the debutant Pathum Nissanka followed him soon after. Thirimanne though continued to score runs from one end as he brought up his 7th Test fifty and to give him company is Niroshan Dickwella as they both look to take Sri Lanka to a position of strongness.
Another superb session for West Indies but Sri Lanka too should not get upset as Lahiru Thirimanne has held one end up and scored too.
Fullish and around middle, Dickwells pushes it towards mid on. With that, it is TEA ON DAY 1.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards point for nothing.
Too wide outside off to make Dickwella go after it.
Shortish and around middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, Dickwella lets it go.
Back of a length ball on middle, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy and around off, Niroshan takes a big stride forward and blocks.

There goes Dickwella. He wants to play the sweep but is not able to connect. It was a lovely loopy ball just outside off, it spun away after landing and Dickwell connected with only thin air with the sweep shot.
Flat and just around off, kept out.
Outside off once again. Dickwella watches it go to the keeper.
Shortish and outside off, punched to the point fielder.
Floated outside off, Dickwella lets it be.
Fuller but wide outside off, left alone this time by Thirimanne.
Good length and around off, kept out.

Edged but safe! They just moved that fielder to third man. A shortish length ball outside off, Dickwella looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge. The ball goes between the third slip and the gully fielder. There was a man in the 4th slip before this ball but they moved him to third man. A single taken but if he was there, it would've been easily gobbled.
Angling away from the left-hander after landing on a good length around middle and leg. Dickwella lets it be.
Full and on middle, Thirimanne flicks it on the leg side and takes one.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Jason Holder is back on.
Shortish and around middle, it is clipped through short fine leg for an easy single.

In the air... safe! Dickwella connected the sweep this time but he failed to time it as well as he would've liked. It takes the top edge and goes high in the air towards deep square leg. The ball lands safely near the ropes. Three taken.
Floated outside off, spinning further away. Left alone.

Swing and a miss! You will get these things with Dickwella on the crease. He is not someone who likes to keep the ball on the ground. He always looks for the scoring opportunity. A tossed up ball on middle, Dickwella gets down and looks to slog sweep. Misses to connect.

Flat and outside off, Thirimanne comes on the front foot and looks to defend but the ball takes the outer half and goes towards short third man. The man from backward point chases it and keeps it to one.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the off side.
Shortish and just outside off, poked towards backward point.
Slips this one down the leg side. Dickwella looks to flick but misses. De Silva does well to collect to his right.
Excellent running! Good length ball on middle, Dickwella works it through mid-wicket and scampers back for two.
Beaten! Full and outside off, Dickwella looks to play the big-booming drive through the covers. Beaten for the inside edge.
Banged short and down the leg side. Dickwella looks to hammer it over the leg side but misses to connect.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Full and round off, pushed towards the cover region.
Short and wide outside off, Thirimanne cuts it hard but cannot get it past the point fielder.
Full and on middle, it is tucked through backward square leg for a run.
Flat and just outside off, punched on the off side.
Tossed up and outside off, poked towards backward point this time.
Floated outside off, spinning away. Dickwella lets it be.
Full and around off, Thirimanne defends it out.
On middle, kept out from the crease.
Short one around middle, Thirimanne looks to evade this one but he takes his eyes off the ball and wears the blow onto his body.
On middle, flicked away to short mid-wicket.
Length and outside off, not in the playing zone of Thirimanne as Lahiru makes a leave.
Length and around off, Lahiru blocks it off the front foot this time.
Full on leg, Niroshan paddles it fine towards fine leg and takes a couple of runs on offer.
On off, watchfully kept out.

Turn and bounce there! Tossed up around middle and turning away from Dickwella as he goes for the sweep. The keeper too fails to collect it as the ball goes to fine leg. A couple of runs taken. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Sliding around middle, turned to square leg for a single.
Loopy on middle, punched down to mid on.
Full on off, played to covers.
Rahkeem Cornwall is back on.
Straying one on the pads of Thirimanne, Lahiru nudges it to square leg for a single.
On middle and leg, Dickwella tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Length and outside off, left alone for the keeper.

Short of a length and around off, Thirimanne punches it towards covers for a single. He brings up his 7th Test fifty in Tests. A fighting innings from him and Sri Lanka would want from him a big contribution.
Around a length and outside off, Lahiru makes a leave.
Short and down leg, Thirimanne sits under it.
Full and around off, Lahiru strokes it through covers and manages to get three runs with ease before the ball gets fielded.
Fuller and outside off, Thirimanne drives it to covers.
Fuller on off, Thirimanne plays it to covers.
Fuller on off, Lahiru plays it to covers.
On a length and around off, Thirimanne plays it to mid on.
BEATEN! Length and angled around off, it straightens after pitching as Thirimanne looks to poke at it but is beaten all ends up.
Length and outside off, Dickwella looks to slash it away but is beaten.
Fuller on off, Dickwella drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and on off, Dickwella plays it to point.
On middle, Dickwella tucks it on the bounce to short leg.
Short of good length and outside off, Dickwella hops and fends it away to cover-point.
Full and on the pads, flicked away towards fine leg for another single by Thirimanne.
Outside off, Left alone.
FOUR! Slashed! Short of a length and outside off,  Dickwella once again thows his bat at this one and gets it uppishly towards third man for another boundary.
Very full and outside off, Niroshan drives it to mid on.
EDGED AND FOUR! 100 comes up for Sri Lanka. Full and outside off, Dickwella throws his bat at it but ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length and outside off, Dickwella pushes it off the back foot once again but this time to covers.
Length ball outside off, Dickwella pushes it off the back foot towards point.
Full and angled outside off, Lahiru has no issues to leave it.
Bumper on middle, Thirimanne ducks under it.
Another length ball around off, Dickwella pats it softly towards covers and scampers for a single.
Full and on leg, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, Lahiru nudges it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, left alone by Thirimanne.
Good length and around off, Niroshan watchfully keeps it out.
Good length and outside off, Dickwella lets it be.
Length and outside off left alone.
Niroshan Dickwella joins Lahiru Thirimanne in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! The debutant departs cheaply. This is vintage West Indies bowling. Excellent length and Roach earns the reward for consistency. Length ball around off, a hint of away movement on this one as Nissanka looks to defend it off the back foot. He though gets a thick outside edge which flies towards the second slip where Holder pouches it. Half the side done and dusted and the score has not crossed 100. Big, big trouble for Sri Lanka.
Good length and on middle, Thirimanne tucks it off the back foot towards the leg side and takes a quick single.
Length and around off, Lahiru blocks it off the front foot this time.

DRINKS! Another hour goes to the home team. They were just brilliant after the break and the introduction of Roach earned him the wicket of Dhananjaya de Silva too. West Indies have not put a foot wong so far in this Test. Though Shannon Gabriel has been disappointing but the others have done well to compensate him. Sri Lanka have been over cautious and that has caused them to lose 4 wickets.
Good length and on  off, driven through covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Nissanka taps it to the off side for a single.
On a length and around middle, nudged to mid-wicket this time.
Short of length ball outside off, Nissanka drops his wrists to let the ball go through.
Full and on leg, Thirimanne clips it uppishly over Holder at leg gully and towards fine leg. A single taken.
Short and way outside off, no need to play at it and Thirimanne does the same thing.
Alzarri Joseph is back on.
Roach bowls it on a length and around off, Nissanka block it out by coming right behind the line of the bat.
Another fuller one around off, Pathum plays it with soft hands to gully.
Outside off, left alone by Nissanka.

FOUR! In the air... But safe! Short ball around off, Nissanka slaps it uppishly towards covers. Short cover there looks to pluck it with one hand but the ball evades him and races to the fence behind for a boundary.
Full and angled on off, Pathum strokes it down to mid on this time.
Fuller length ball around off, blocked off the front foot by Nissanka.
Full again and around off, Thirimanne blocks off the front foot.
Full ball on middle, stroked to mid off.
Full ball on the pads, flicked over mid-wicket for two.
Length ball around middle, kept out.
Fullish and around off, Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball takes the inner half and goes on the leg side.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
WIDE! Gabriel continues to bowl poor lines. It is well wide outside off. Left alone. The umpire calls it wide again.
WIDE! Big swing there. A length ball outside off, it lands and keeps going away as Thirimanne lets it go behind. Called wide.
Around off on a good length, Nissanga plants his front foot and blocks. End of a successful over from Roach.

FOUR! First runs for Nissanka in Tests. A gift from the bowler to the new man. Roach probably went for the big swinging yorker but ended up bowling one down the leg side. Nissanka flicks it down to the fine leg fence to open his account.
Who comes out to bat now? Pathum Nissanka, the debutant walks out to bat for the first time in his Test career.

OUT! TIMBER! Knocks him over! An absolute beauty from Roach. De Silva has to go. After taking three balls away, this one comes back in. De Silva is a bit late in getting his bat down. Also, leaving a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through that gap to shatter the woodwork behind. The budding stand has been broken.
Full and outside off, this time de Silva lets it be this time.
Another ripper from Roach. This one shapes away after landing on a good length around off. De Silva had to play at it. He did that but only to get beaten.

Draws the edge first ball. Good from Roach but Thirimanne played it with soft hands there. A fullish ball outside off, Thirimanne gets on the front foot and looks to defend. The ball takes the outside edge but falls well short of the first slip fielder.  The fielder fumbles and they cross.
Kemar Roach is back on. 7-1-18-0 from him so far.
Kemar Roach is back on. 7-1-18-0 from him so far.
Low full toss, pushed to mid off for nothing.

FOUR! THUMP! Another excellent stroke off the willow of de Silva. Gabriel this time bowls it a full ball around off, de Silva punches the drive down the ground. No one is even thinking of stopping that. Perfect time.
Good length ball around middle, it is tucked towards fine leg for one by Thirimanne.
Fullish and around off, kept out.
A back of a length ball on middle, pulled to mid-wicket for a run.
A single to begin the over. Around off on a length, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Short and wide outside off, de Silva looks to crunch it on the off side but ends up getting off the toe end of the bat.
FOUR! SHOT! GORGEOUS! Lovely stroke! Shot of the day! Little too full from Holder. Da Silva nails the drive past the bowler and into the long off fence.
In the channel outside off, de Silva lets it go to the keeper.
Driven nicely! Full and wide outside off, de Silva drives it through mid off and gets two.
Length ball around off, pushed to mid on.
Full and on the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball goes to the right side of the keeper and they sneak a leg bye.
Back of a length ball on middle, this time de Silva works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, de Silva looks to force it on the off side but ends up hitting it off the bottom edge towards point.
Fullish and around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for one.
Slips another one down the leg side. Thirimanne lets it be.
Short of length and angled on middle, Thirimanne looks to defend it but the ball skids on to beat his defensive push to hit him on the thigh pad.
Full and on the pads, clipped away towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Full on off, stroked down to mid off this time.
Short of a length and around off, dabbed to cover-point off the back foot again.
Another ball landing outside off and the batsman does not have anything to do with it.
Beaten! Length and around off, de Silva looks to defend it but the ball bounces a bit extra as it goes past the outside edge
On a length and outside off, de Silva taps it off the back foot to point again.
Full and outside off, squeezed to point by Dhananjaya.
Short of good length around middle, Thirimanne hops and tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Another delivery going down leg as Lahiru fails to get bat on ball on it.
Full and on leg, Thirimanne looks to clip it to the leg side but misses it to get get rapped on the pads. There is an appeal but nothing from the umpire. Struck outside the leg stump there.
Length ball going down leg, Thirimanne looks to glance it fine but cannot get anything on the ball.
Length and around off, coming into the batsman but not enough to make him play.
Length and angled across off, Lahiru lets it be.
Full on leg, whipped away to fine leg for a run.
Nicely bowled! Length and across the left-hander, Thirimanne looks to defend it with his bat and pad close to each other but is beaten on the outside edge this time.
Full and around off, blocked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Length and in the channel of uncertainty, Lahiru does not play at it.
Length and inswinging into Thirimanne, Lahiru tucks it to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Good single! Length and around off, de Silva dabs it to the leg side and scampers for a quick run.
Full and on off, stroked towards covers for a quick single on offer.
Length ball on the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick it away but cannot get wood on the ball as it goes off his pads towards deep square leg for a single. A leg bye taken.
And again, going outside off after pitching on a length and Lahiru shoulders arms to it.
On a similar length as the previous ball and Lahiru again does not offer a shot. Three leaves in a row.
Another length ball and quickly leaving Thirimanne there, Lahiru has no issues to leave it.
Good length and angled away from Lahiru, Thirimanne lets it be.
Who will bowl from the other end after the break? Shannon Gabriel to bowl now. 4-1-7-0 from him so far.
Beauty to end the over! Banged on a fuller length and around off, de Silva is squared up he looks to defend it. Luckily the edge is not found at this instance.
Length and around off, this time de Silva blocks it from the middle of the bat.
Short of a good length around off, de Silva looks to defend it off the front foot but can only block it off the higher part of the bat.
Good length and outside off, Dhananjaya lifts his bat and lets the ball sail through to the keeper.
Length and down leg, de Silva looks to flick but misses it.

Time for the second session of this first Test between Sri Lanka and the West Indies. The two unbeaten batsmen for Sri Lanka, Lahiru Thirimanne and Dhananjaya de Silva  stride out to the middle. The West Indies players too are out in the middle. Jason Holder to continue the over.
...  DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Rakheem Cornwall is caught for a little chat before the second session starts. The big man says that he was looking to bowl in the right areas and build pressure. Tells that his aim was to not give away easy runs. On playing in West Indies, Cornwall says that he is really happy about it. Says that he is trying to bowl in the right areas and wants the ball to do the rest.

So, an excellent session for West Indies They will look to return for the second session and keep the momentum with them. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, need to stitch a big stand, if they are to get anywhere close to 275-300, as hoped by the skipper at the toss. The second session coming your way shortly.

After winning the toss, West Indies decided to bowl and the skipper pointed the moisture on the wicket. Roach started well but Gabriel struggled to get his line right in the first couple of overs. However, they kept things really tight. Cornwall was called on early and he struck to provide the breakthrough as Karunaratne departed. Oshada didn't last long as he got run out trying to steal a single on the call of his partner Thirimanne. Thirimanne looked decent and has scored most of the runs for the Lankans in this session. Chandimal kept blocking things. He was eventually sent packing by Holder just at the stroke of the Lunch.

West Indies have got the big wicket of Chandimal right at the stroke of the Lunch and they will be mighty pleased with their efforts. They kept things tight throughout and never allowed the opposition to control the game. An engrossing session and West Indies will take the honours of winning the session.

Review time! Chandimal has been given out caught behind. Chandimal after having a discussion with his partner signals the 'T'. There was some noise as the ball went past the bat. And Ultra Edge is able to catch that. A big spike on it. Waste of a review from Chandimal but he still looks shocked with the result as he walks back. With this, it is LUNCH ON DAY 1.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant bowling from Holder and he reaps the reward for it. Another wicket for West Indies right at the stroke of Lunch. Good length and around off, Chandimal hangs his bat out looking to defend the ball. The ball though takes the edge and flies safely into the mitts of the keeper. There is an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Chandimal though thinks otherwise as he takes the review and the replays roll in. The ball is very close to the bat as the third umpire asks for Ultra Edge. The Ultra Edge comes up and it shows a big spike when the ball is close to the bat. Sri Lanka lose a wicket as well as a review.
Full and in the channel around off, Thirimanne is aware of his off pole as he makes a close and watchful leave.
Fuller and down leg, Lahiru looks to glance it fine but cannot get wood on  the ball.
Outside off, left alone for the wicketkeeper this time.
Fuller around off, Thirimanne goes for the drive through the off side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to mid-wcket.
Short of length and just around off, Lahiru looks to cut it but ends up chopping it to gully.
Fuller in length and around off, Thirimanne defends it out safely.
This time keeps it on a length and angles into the pads, Thirimanne tucks it past square leg for a single.
Slightly drags his length back does Holder as Lahiru turns it away to square leg.
Another one bowled on a length and around off, Lahiru is happy to play it out to the leg side.
On a length and around off, Lahiru keeps it out off the back foot towards the leg side.
Short of a good length and around off, Lahiru blocks it off the back foot.
Good length and outside off, Thirimanne watches it and then leaves it alone for the keeper.
Length and outside off, Chandimal blocks it towards cover-point where a misfield from the fielder allows the batsmen to sneak in a brace.
Another good length ball outside off, Chandimal does not feel the need to play at it.
On middle, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run. sensible batting for these two.
FOUR! Cut away uppishly! Short and wide outside off, Thirimanne waits for it before scooping it over gully and into the third man fence for a boundary. 50-up for Sri Lanka also comes up.
Fuller and outside off, Thirimanne looks to drive it through the off side but the ball takes the inside half of the bat towards deep square leg for a couple.
Bumper on leg, Lahiru sits under it.
Outside off, easy leave for Dinesh this time.
Another fuller one from Holder and Chandimal tries to flick it away but is beaten to get hit on the pads. Going down leg certainly and hence no appeal. The ball rolls to the off side.
Full and on the pads, Thirimanne tucks it through to fine leg for a run now.
Another fuller and angled away from the left-hander, Lahiru shoulders arms to this one.
Length and down leg, Thirimanne misses his flick as the keeper collects it.
Fuller length ball around off. Thirimanne strokes it to short cover now.
On a length and around off, Chandimal drives but finds short cover.
A speedy yorker on middle, Chandimal does well to take his legs out of the line of fire before digging it out.
Good length and on middle, Thirimanne shuffles across his stumps before clipping it to fine leg for a single.
Now bowls one outside off, and Thirimanne lets it be once again.
Length and down leg, easy leave for Thirimanne this time.
Beaten! Length and angling across the left-hander, Lahiru looks to cut it off the back foot but the ball is too close to play that shot. He gets beaten in the end.
Another good length delivery around off, Dinesh keeps it out to the off side. Good start for Holder there.
Fuller and around off, blocked away off the front foot to the off side.
Length and swinging away from Dinesh, Chandimal leaves it alone.

Edged but short of the second slip fielder. Length and in the channel around off, Chandimal is caught inside the crease while defending. The ball takes the outside edge and drops well short of the second slip fielder.
Fuller and around off, Lahiru looks to defend it by coming half-forward. The ball though takes the inside edge and goes between his legs towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length and angled outside off, Lahiru lets it be.
Jason Holder is into the attack now.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked wide of the man at mid-wicket for a single. The fielder was a bit too casual in picking up the ball. Chandimal thought of taking the second but they opted against it.
Shortish and around off, Thirimanne keeps it out.
Shortish and just outside off, punched on the off side.
Floated around middle, Thirimanne keeps it out.
Back of a length and around off, solidly kept out off the back foot.
Back of a length and outside off, left alone.
On off, Dinesh is solid in defense once again.
Flat and around off, defended off the front foot.
On the pads, Chadimal pads it away.
Floated short and on middle, clipped towards short fine leg.
Flat and just outside off, Chandimal stays back to block it on the off side.
Floated around off, blocked.
Fullish and outside off, left alone.
Good length and around middle, tucked on the leg side for nothing.
FOUR! Nicely done! A little too full and down the leg side. Thirimanne flicks it down to the fine leg fence. That was the attempted yorker from Joseph.
Length ball on middle, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.
Shortish and angling away, left alone.
A poor ball from Joseph to begin. Thirimanne flicks it wide of fine leg for two.
Alzarri Joseph is on now.
Flat and around off, kept out.
Nicely bowled. Loopy ball outside off, it lands and spins in. Chandimal looks to defend but the ball bounces high and hits the pad.
Uppish but wide! Full and around off, spins. Chandimal looks to defend but the ball spins in and takes the inside edge. It goes between leg slip and leg short leg.
Good shot! Slightly shrot and on middle and leg. It is punched through mid-wicket. It is racing towards the fence but the man from mid-wicket chases it down. Three taken.
Flat and around off, blocked off the front foot.
Floated around off, played back to the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, Chandimal leaves it alone.
This one is slipped down the leg side. Left alone.
Another one wide outside off, Dinesh leaves it alone.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Chandimal is up and running! Full and wide outside off, Chandimal squeezes it through backward point for two.
Dinesh Chandimal is the next batsman in for Sri Lanka

OUT! RUN OUT! Direct hits are always close and here, Fernando is well short. What terrific work in the field by skipper Brathwaite. It was a risky single and Oshada has to pay the price now. Good length ball around off, Thirimanne drops it near the off side and calls for a single. A bit of hesitation from Fernando but he eventually goes. Brathwaite latches on the ball from the covers and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The third umpire has been called for. One replay and that is enough for the third umpire to give the marching order to Oshada.

Run out check sent upstairs. Direct hits are always close and we have one here. Oshada Fernando is the man in question as the  replays roll in. Looks to be a goner as Brathwaite scores a bull's eye at the keeper's end.
On off, kept out by Fernando.
Slower and down leg, Oshada pads it away.
Fuller on leg, turned to mid-wicket.
Loopy on off, Fernando blocks it to the off side.
On midlde, clipped to short mid-wicket again.
Full on off, whipped to short mid-wicket.
This time makes Lahiru play by bringing the length ball sharply into off, Thirimanne blocks it to the off side off the back foot this time.
This time Roach lands one closer to the uncertainty channel but still  he cannot make Lahiru play as he lets it be.
On the fuller side and angling away from Thirimanne, Lahiru has no fuss in leaving it.
Another good length ball outside off, Lahiru watches it closely before making a leave.
Length and outside off, Thirimanne drops his wrists to let it go through.
Good running! Full and sliding on the pads, Fernando whips it through mid-wicket as the batsmen take three runs before the fielder in the deep mops it up.

DRINKS! A good first hour of cricket for the home team. They kept the pressure on and that resulted in the wicket of the Sri Lankan skipper. Roach and Cornwall have been superb with the ball but Gabriel was a bit wayward as he struggled to keep his lines and lengths consistent. Sri Lanka have a task in hand as they look to stitch a partnership to take them into the ascendency. West Indies on the other hand would look to pick up wickets at regular intervals to not allow the Sri Lankan batsmen to set into a rhythm.
Floated around middle, Fernando tucks it past John Campbell at short leg. It was a bit in the air as the ball went past him. A single taken.
Slightly shorter around off, Lahiru punches it through cover-point for a run.
Floated around off, driven firmly to short cover this time.
On off, blocked with soft hand to slips.
Fuller outside off, driven off the back foot to point.
Flatter around off, Lahiru punches it through covers off the back foot for a couple of runs.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and on leg, Lahiru looks to clip it to the leg side but he misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side as the batsmen sneak a leg bye.
Good length and going away from Thirimanne, Lahiru makes a leave.
Full on middle, Lahiru blocks it to mid on off the front foot.
Length and in the channel around off, coming in with the angle but after pitching moves away from Lahiru as he looks to poke at it but gets beaten.

FOUR! Thirimanne gets a boundary! Though off the edge! A rare one so far in the Sri Lankan innings. Length ball around off, once again leaving the batsman after pitching. Lahiru gets squared up as he looks to defend it. The ball takes the soft outside edge and goes between slip and gully and into the third man fence for a boundary.
Flighted on middle, Fernando turns it to the leg side this time. A wicket maiden from Cornwall.
Floated around off, Fernando pushes it to the leg side.
Oshada Fernando is the new man in with the bat for Sri Lanka at no.3.

OUT! TAKEN! Cornwall strikes and West Indies have got the first wicket. A sharp take at short leg from Campbell. Karunaratne fails to make use of the chance he got in the last over when Blackwood slipped it. This was darted on middle and leg, Dimuth looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting a thick inside edge. The ball goes uppishly towards short leg where Campbell snaffles the chance nicely.
Floated around off, worked on the leg side for nothing.
Loopy and outside off, turning away. Left alone.
Flat and around off, kept out.

Put down! That should've been taken. Roach is not pleased. Full and wide outside off, Karunaratne goes for the drive away from his body. Ends up getting an outside edge. Blackwood at point leaps a touch but fails to hold on. How costly will this be?
Outside off, left alone.
Fuller and around off, pushed to the point region.
DRS time!

NOT OUT! Nothing on the Ultra Edge and West Indies lose a review as Dimuth Karunaratne survives. That's a peach from Roach. Simply unplayable. Landing one around off and coming in with the angle. Karunaratne looks to poke at it off the back foot but misses it. Joshua da Silva behind collects the ball and goes up in an appeal as the bowler joins in. Brathwaite takes the review on the insistence of Roach. Replays roll in as the Ultra Edge comes on and shows that there is flat line when the ball passes the bat. Dimuth survives to fight it out for Sri Lanka.
Pitched up fuller and outside off, Karunaratne lets the ball go to Joshua.
Good length and around off, Dimuth looks to defend it but is beaten to get hit high on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the off side then.
Kemar Roach has change of ends as he returns for his second spell.

6 balls from Cornwall and Thirimanne gets beaten thrice, This is good bowling from Rakheem..  Floated around off, Lahiru is on the back foot as he looks to defend it but the ball spins past his outside edge.
Flatter around off, punched off the back foot to point.
On middle, pushed to the leg side this time.
Similar delivery and Thirimanne is beaten once again.
BEATEN! Floated in the channel around off, Lahiru looks to defend it but is beaten on the outside edge.
Full and darting on off, Lahiru shows the full face of the bat as he blocks it out.
Short of good length and around middle, Dimuth hops and fends it right near his boot. The ball later rolls to the off side.
On a good length and down leg, Dimuth lets the ball go through to the keeper by lifting his bat high in the air.
BEATEN! Beauty! This is where he needs to bowl more often. In the channel around off, going away from Karunaratne, Dimuth goes for a drive away from his body but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A lot better from Shannon. Lands one on a length and on the seam. Gets it to angle away from the left-hander. Dimuth watches it and then shoulders arms to it.
Length and outside leg, some movement on this one as the keeper dives to his left to collect it.
Full and coming into middle and leg, Lahiru looks to defend it to the leg side but the ball goes off the inner half to fine leg for a single.
Floated outside off, Dimuth has no issues in leaving this one. A maiden to start for Cornwall.
Flighted outside off, inviting the drive from Karunaratne. Dimuth goes for the drive but ends up playing it straight to covers.
Loopy outside off, Dimuth pushes it to covers again.
Tossed up ball around off, Karunaratne punches it to covers.
Shorter and flatter outside off, turning away as Dimuth plays it to point.
Floated around off, Dimuth blocks it from the crease.
Rahkeem Cornwall is introduced into the attack very early. Two slips in place. One man at short leg.

Full and angled on leg, Karunaratne looks to flick it through mid-wicket but does not get the timing right on the shot as the ball stops near the ropes. The fielder fields it but not before the batsmen take three runs.
One good ball and Gabriel is back to bowling one down leg as Dimuth does not offer as stroke to it.
This is where he needs to bowl. Fuller and around off, Karunaratne blocks it from within the crease this time. Encouragement from West Indies players for Gabriel.
Garbiel is struggling big time here as he bowls another one down leg, Dimuth is happy to make a leave.
Another length ball down leg, Dimuth this time sways away from the line as well as lifts his willow to let the ball sail through to the keeper.
Full and straying on the pads of Lahiru, Thirimanne looks to flick it to the leg side but gets it off the pads. A single taken. Leg bye given.
Full and just outside off, Dimuth looks to drive but it takes the inside half and goes to mid on.
Full and just outside off, Dimuth looks to drive but it takes the inside half and goes to mid on.
Slips this one down the leg side, first poor ball from Roach. Dimuth looks to flick but misses.
Around off on a length, kept out.

EDGED BUT FOUR! Roach once again bowls it full and wide outside off, Dimuth reaches out and looks to drive. He ends up getting an outside edge but the ball goes between the gully and slip fielder. Into the third man fence.
Too full toss outside off, Karunaratne drives it wide of mid off for two.
Another one down the leg side. Thirimanne once again fails to flick. A relatively easy take for the keeper.
Slips this one down the leg side, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses. Good take from Joshua down the leg side, to his right.
Shortish but little wide outside off. Thirimanne has no problem leaving it alone.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Edgy! A length ball around off, angles in. Thirimanne looks to defend but ends up getting a thickish outisde edge. The gully fielder does well to make a stop to his left.
Back of a length ball outside off, another leave from Thirimanne.
Another one in the channel outside off, Dimuth leaves it alone.
Shortish and outside off, left alone.
Length ball around off, pushed on the leg side.
Full and outside off, poked wide of the man at point for a single.
Absolute peach! Roach runs in and bowls a good length ball just outside off, it lands and comes back in. Lahiru Thirimanne looks to defend but misses.
Quick single! Length ball around off, Karunaratne pushes it gently towards mid on and takes a quick single.
A slight halt in play as there is some issue with the sightscreen. Karunaratne wants the sightscreen to be adjusted properly. Finally, it is done and Roach is ready to start his 2nd over.
Now, this one is down the leg side. Lahiru looks to flick but misses. Not quite the first over Gabriel would've liked to bowl.
WIDE! Way wide outside off, left alone. This time the umpire decides to have some excercise. Wided.

Karunaratne is off the mark as well. That was another poor ball but Dimuth failed to time it as well as he would've liked. Short and wide outside off, Karunaratne looks to slam it on the off side but it hits the toe end and goes past the mid off fielder. A single taken as the fielder chases it down.
Thirimanne and Sri Lanka are up and running. A loose ball once again from Gabriel. A high full toss on the pads, Thirimanne flicks it to fine leg for an easy single.
Too wide again, pretty similar to the first ball. Left alone.

Gets the line and length perfect this time. Gabriel runs in and bowls this on a shortish length. It lands around middle and moves away. Thirimanne stays back and pokes at it, only to get beaten for the outside edge.
A wayward start from Shannon. It is way outside off on a fullish length. Thirimanne lets it be.
Shannon Gabriel will partner Roach from the other end.
A maiden to start from Roach. The last ball is on a good length and around off, Dimuth tucks it towards mid-wicket. He thinks for a single but opts against it. Quality first over from Roach.

Beaten this time! A ripper from Roach. He runs in and bowls one to shape away. This is slightly on the shorter side. It lands and comes in a touch but as it gets closer to the bat, it moves away to beat the outside edge.
In the channel outside off, Dimuth this time lets it go to the keeper.
Just around off on a good length. Karunaratne gets on the front foot and taps it onto the pitch on the off side.
And again! Lovely from Roach early on. He once again lands this one just around off and angles it in. Karunaratne looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pad.
Lovely start from Roach. He is right on the money! A good length ball around off, angled in. Karunaratne looks to defend but ends up getting an inside edge on the pad.

We are all set to begin the action.  The two Sri Lankan openers, Dimiuth Karunaratne and Lahiru Thirmanne are out in the middle. The West Indies players are out and ready to start as they spread on the field. Kemar Roach to start with the new ball first up.

Samul Badree is in with pitch report alongside Courtney Walsh. Badree says that the batsmen will get value for their shots on this wickets. Tells that there is a bit fo grass and mositure which will assist the pacers. Walsh says that the surface will hold on for all the 5 days.

Dimuth Karunaratne, the Sri Lankan skipper, says that he too was looking to bowl first. Talking about their past performance, Dimuth says that the past records do inspire them but they need to be in the present and give their best for the team. Tells that Nissanka is making his debut in this game for them. Aims to put on anything around 275-300.

Sri Lanka XI - Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Lahiru Thirimanne, Oshada Fernando, Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Pathum Nissanka (ON DEBUT), Niroshan Dickwella (WK), Suranga Lakmal, Vishwa Fernando, Lasith Embuldeniya, Dushmantha Chameera.

Kraigg Brathwaite, the West Indies captain, feels that the pitch has a bit of moisture and he feels that will help their pacers early on. Informs that Darren Bravo and Jomel Warrican are the two players who are missing out. Tells that they need to show a good attitude and they need to be disciplined. Adds that they are ready to get going in this series.

West Indies XI - Kraigg Brathwaite (C), John Campbell, Nkrumah Bonner, Joshua Da Silva (WK), Jermaine Blackwood, Kyle Mayers, Jason Holder, Rahkeem Cornwall, Alzarri Joseph, Kemar Roach, Shannon Gabriel.

TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin. Kraigg Brathwaite and Dimuth Karunaratne are the two captains out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of Kraigg Brathwaite. WEST INDIES OPT TO BOWL!

We are done with the white-ball leg of Sri Lanka's tour of the West Indies. So far the T20Is and ODIs have gone the West Indies' way. They would hope to carry the same form for the Tests and with a new skipper, Kraigg Brathwaite taking over from Jason Holder. West Indies would be flying high after their away series win against Bangladesh. Sri Lanka too would want to start the longest format fresh. They had to taste defeat at home against England. So contrasting results in their last series would be riding on the minds of both the teams. West Indies would be raring to have a crack at the Sri Lankan team and this new look West-Indies team is high on confidence. Can the Sri Lankan team put up a fight? Stay tuned to find out as the toss and team updates come your way shortly.
